functions.name: BERNOULLI
functions.description: Random draw from a Bernoulli distribution: 1 with probability p, else 0.

functions.name: BETA
functions.description: Random draw from a Beta distribution on 0..1.

functions.name: BETA4
functions.description: Random draw from a Beta distribution rescaled to min..max.

functions.name: BINOMIAL
functions.description: Random draw from a Binomial distribution.

functions.name: CHISQ
functions.description: Random draw from a Chi-square distribution with k degrees of freedom.

functions.name: DELAPORTE
functions.description: Random draw from a Delaporte distribution: Poisson(Gamma(alpha,beta)) + Poisson(gamma).

functions.name: DICE
functions.description: Random whole number from 1 to sides, inclusive.

functions.name: ERLANG
functions.description: Random draw from an Erlang distribution.

functions.name: EXPONENTIAL
functions.description: Random draw from an Exponential distribution with mean beta.

functions.name: GAMMA
functions.description: Random draw from a Gamma distribution with shape alpha and scale beta.

functions.name: GEOMETRIC
functions.description: Random draw from a Geometric distribution, counted from 0.

functions.name: HYPERGEOMETRIC
functions.description: Random draw from a Hypergeometric distribution.

functions.name: INVERSEGAUSSIAN
functions.description: Random draw from an Inverse Gaussian distribution.

functions.name: LOGISTIC
functions.description: Random draw from a Logistic distribution.

functions.name: LOGLOGISTIC
functions.description: Random draw from a Log-logistic distribution.

functions.name: LOGNORMAL
functions.description: Random draw from a Lognormal distribution, given its own mean and SD.

functions.name: LOGNORMAL2
functions.description: Random draw from a Lognormal distribution, given mu and sigma of the log.

functions.name: NEGBINOMIAL
functions.description: Random draw from a Negative binomial distribution.

functions.name: NORMAL
functions.description: Random draw from a Normal distribution.

functions.name: PARETO
functions.description: Random draw from a Pareto distribution.

functions.name: PEARSON5
functions.description: Random draw from a Pearson V distribution.

functions.name: PEARSON6
functions.description: Random draw from a Pearson VI distribution.

functions.name: PERT
functions.description: Random draw from a Beta-Pert distribution with minimum a, mode m and maximum b.

functions.name: POISSON
functions.description: Random draw from a Poisson distribution.

functions.name: POLYA
functions.description: Random draw from a Polya distribution: Poisson(Gamma(alpha,beta)).

functions.name: RAYLEIGH
functions.description: Random draw from a Rayleigh distribution.

functions.name: RELATIVERISK
functions.description: Random relative risk with lognormal spread, corrected so its mean equals RR.

functions.name: STUDENTST
functions.description: Random draw from Student's t distribution.

functions.name: TRIANGLE
functions.description: Random draw from a Triangular distribution.

functions.name: UNIFORM01
functions.description: Random draw uniform between 0 and 1, exclusive.

functions.name: UNIFORM
functions.description: Random draw uniform between min and max, exclusive.

functions.name: WEIBULL
functions.description: Random draw from a Weibull distribution. alpha is scale and beta is shape, the reverse of Excel.

functions.name: EMPIRICAL
functions.description: Random draw from a distribution you define with x values and weights p.

functions.name: SURVIVAL
functions.description: Random remaining survival time from conditional failure probabilities, given survival to time ct.

functions.name: SURVIVAL2
functions.description: As PSA.SURVIVAL, using your own uniform draw rnd, so two arms can share one draw.

functions.name: NONPARAM
functions.description: Master for non-parametric bootstrapping. Returns its name.

functions.name: NONPARAMCOM
functions.description: Bootstrapped value for one record and field. Link name to the PSA.NONPARAM cell.

functions.name: RANDOMISE
functions.description: Master for a randomisation test. Returns its name.

functions.name: RANDOMISECOM
functions.description: Reshuffled value for one record and field. Link name to the PSA.RANDOMISE cell.

functions.name: MULTINOMIAL
functions.description: Master for a Multinomial distribution. Returns its name.

functions.name: MULTINOMIALCOM
functions.description: Multinomial draw for one category. Draws across categories sum to N.

functions.name: DIRICHLET
functions.description: Master for a Dirichlet distribution. Returns its name.

functions.name: DIRICHLETCOM
functions.description: Dirichlet draw for one category. Draws across categories sum to 1.

functions.name: CORRNORMAL
functions.description: Master for correlated Normals. C is a lower-triangle correlation or covariance matrix.

functions.name: CORRNORMALCOM
functions.description: One correlated Normal draw. Link name to the PSA.CORRNORMAL cell.

functions.name: RANKCORR
functions.description: Master for rank-correlated distributions. C is a lower-triangle correlation matrix.

functions.name: RANKCORRCOM
functions.description: One rank-correlated draw. func must be an Ersatz random function embedded directly in this formula.

functions.name: DIRICHLETCORR
functions.description: Master for correlated Dirichlet distributions.

functions.name: DIRICHLETCORRIN
functions.description: Parameters of correlated Dirichlet distribution num.

functions.name: DIRICHLETCORROUT
functions.description: Draws for correlated Dirichlet distribution num. Spills across its categories.

functions.name: MULTINOMIALCORR
functions.description: Master for correlated Multinomial distributions.

functions.name: MULTINOMIALCORRIN
functions.description: Parameters of correlated Multinomial distribution num.

functions.name: MULTINOMIALCORROUT
functions.description: Draws for correlated Multinomial distribution num. Spills across its categories.

functions.name: OUTPUT
functions.description: Records value on each iteration and reports it in the results. Returns value.

functions.name: RUNOUTPUT
functions.description: Records value once at the end of each run. Returns value.

functions.name: SENSINPUT
functions.description: Names an input for sensitivity analysis. Returns value.

functions.name: RUNSENSINPUT
functions.description: Names an input for sensitivity analysis across runs. Returns value.

functions.name: DATA
functions.description: After the run, returns the value inp had on iteration itnum. Returns 0 during the run.

functions.name: DATAARRAY
functions.description: After the run, spills innum from every iteration down a column.

functions.name: RUNDATAARRAY
functions.description: After all runs, spills value from the end of every run down a column.

functions.name: MINIMIZE
functions.description: Parameters being optimised, starting from range ir. Spills to the same shape as ir.

functions.name: MINIMIZERESULT
functions.description: Loss value the optimiser minimises. Must share its name with PSA.MINIMIZE.

functions.name: ONEOFFCOSTDISC
functions.description: Cost co at time cy, discounted to base year by at fractional rate r.

functions.name: ANNUALCOSTDISC
functions.description: Annual cost co from sy to ly, discounted to base year by at fractional rate r.

functions.name: LYDISC
functions.description: Life years from sy to ly, discounted to base year by at fractional rate r.

functions.name: HALYDISC
functions.description: Health-adjusted life years from sy to ly, using weights ha by single year of age ag.

functions.name: FIXED
functions.description: Returns element num of range x, wrapping around past the end.

functions.name: CONDITIONAL
functions.description: Returns value when con is TRUE. Otherwise holds the previous result.

functions.name: TRUNCATE
functions.description: Resamples an embedded random function until it falls between min and max.

functions.name: ITERATION
functions.description: Number of the current iteration.

functions.name: SETITNO
functions.description: Sets the number of iterations from the worksheet.

functions.name: RUNNO
functions.description: Number of the current run.

functions.name: RUNNING
functions.description: TRUE while a simulation is running.

functions.name: VERSION
functions.description: Version of this add-in.

functions.name: STORE
functions.description: Stores a number for the next iteration. Returns name.

functions.name: RETRIEVE
functions.description: Number stored by PSA.STORE on the previous iteration. 0 on the first.

functions.name: STOREARRAY
functions.description: Stores a range for the next iteration. Returns name.

functions.name: RETRIEVEARRAY
functions.description: Range stored by PSA.STOREARRAY on the previous iteration.

functions.name: CONDSTOREARRAY
functions.description: Stores a range when condition is TRUE. mode 0 replaces, 1 multiplies, 2 adds.

functions.name: CONDRETRIEVEARRAY
functions.description: Range stored by PSA.CONDSTOREARRAY, updated when condition is TRUE.

functions.name: SORTEDARRAY
functions.description: Sorts a range. mode 1 is ascending, anything else descending.

functions.name: MEAN
functions.description: At the end of a run, the mean of inp across its iterations.

functions.name: STDEV
functions.description: At the end of a run, the standard deviation of inp across its iterations.

functions.name: MIN
functions.description: At the end of a run, the lowest value of inp across its iterations.

functions.name: MAX
functions.description: At the end of a run, the highest value of inp across its iterations.

functions.name: TOTAL
functions.description: At the end of a run, the sum of inp across its iterations.

functions.name: CORRELATION
functions.description: At the end of a run, the Pearson correlation of X and Y across its iterations.

functions.name: PERCENTILE
functions.description: At the end of a run, percentile perc (0 to 100) of inp across its iterations.
